product_overview: Sirindu is a Laravel 12 web application for registering children, recording periodic growth measurements, calculating WHO-based Z-scores, tracking immunizations, and providing analytics, maps, early-warning alerts and surveillance case management for public health staff.
core_goals: Provide reliable child registration and facility-scoped data management for Posyandu and Puskesmas staff
Capture periodic growth measurements and compute WHO Z-scores and classifications in real time
Track immunization schedules and records per child and update coverage analytics
Surface geographic and analytic views (dashboards and maps) to support planning and early intervention
Support epidemiology case management and role-based access control with export capabilities

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate users with email and password to access the system and route them to their scoped dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> Redirect to /admin/home -> See dashboard summary
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password (invalid) -> Submit login form -> See error message on invalid credentials

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Primary dashboard showing summary statistics and navigation to analytics, maps, and management modules for authenticated users.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/home -> View summary statistics cards -> Navigate to /admin/analytics -> See analytics charts
Attempt to access /admin/home without authentication -> Redirect to /login

features.name: Child Data Management (CRUD)
features.description: Register and manage basic child records with identity, parent data and cascading geographic assignment; list and search children.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/data-dasar-anak -> See datatable list of children -> Enter search query by name or NIK -> See filtered results

Navigate to /admin/create-data-dasar-anak -> Fill in personal data and select Kecamatan -> Select Kelurahan -> Select RT and Puskesmas -> Select Posyandu -> Submit child registration form -> See new child in /admin/data-dasar-anak list
Navigate to /admin/create-data-dasar-anak -> Fill in form with NIK that already exists -> Submit child registration form -> See duplicate NIK error
Navigate to /admin/data-dasar-anak -> Select a child row to delete -> Confirm deletion -> See child removed from list

features.name: Child Growth Data Entry
features.description: Record periodic measurements (height, weight, position, date) for a child, apply measurement adjustments, and display measurement list and growth chart.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/data-anak/{id} -> View list of periodic measurements for the child -> Add new measurement -> Fill visit date, age in months, measurement position, height and weight -> Submit measurement -> See new measurement in list and updated growth chart
Navigate to /admin/data-anak/{id} -> Add new measurement with measurement date in the future -> Submit measurement -> See validation error for measurement date
Navigate to /admin/data-anak/{id} -> Add measurement with position 'lying' for child under 24 months -> Submit measurement -> See adjusted height applied for calculation and visible on growth chart

features.name: Z-score Calculation & Classification
features.description: Compute BMI and WHO Z-scores (IMT/U, BB/U, TB/U, BB/TB) after each measurement and classify nutritional status using SD cutoffs.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/data-anak/{id} -> View a measurement record -> System calculates BMI and Z-score indicators -> See Z-score values and nutritional status classifications displayed for each indicator

Navigate to /admin/data-anak/{id} where WHO reference rows are missing -> View a measurement record -> System attempts Z-score calculation -> See 'Data referensi tidak tersedia' and Z-scores not calculated

features.name: Immunization Management
features.description: Auto-generate per-child immunization schedules from vaccine master data and record vaccine events with status updates.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/imunisasi-lengkap/{id} -> View complete immunization list and schedule for the child -> Add immunization record with vaccine type and administration date -> Submit immunization record -> See vaccine status update to completed and schedule update
Navigate to /admin/imunisasi-lengkap/{id} -> View schedule for a child who passed maximum age for a dose -> See vaccine dose flagged as overdue
Navigate to /admin/imunisasi-lengkap/{id} -> Add immunization record with administration date before child's birth date -> Submit immunization record -> See validation error for administration date

features.name: Analytics Dashboard
features.description: Visual analytics for immunization coverage, growth and Z-score distributions with filters by vaccine type and location.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/analytics -> View immunization coverage charts and summary widgets -> Apply filter by immunization type or period -> See charts and statistics update to reflect filter
Navigate to /admin/analytics -> Apply filter that returns no data -> See empty chart states or 'No data' message

features.name: Geographic Map Dashboard
features.description: Interactive Leaflet map showing Posyandu locations, child counts and basic Posyandu statistics by geography.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/map -> View interactive map with markers for Posyandu locations -> Select a marker -> See Posyandu statistics for that location
Navigate to /admin/map -> Map CDN unavailable or geo-coordinate data missing -> See map fail to render and an error or empty-state message

features.name: Early Warning System
features.description: Identify at-risk children using composite risk scoring from measurements and immunization gaps, and produce vaccine needs exports.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/early-warning -> View list of children with risk scores and classifications -> Filter list by location -> See filtered high-risk children sorted by score
Navigate to /admin/early-warning -> Trigger vaccine needs export -> Download Excel with vaccine needs aggregated by location
Navigate to /admin/early-warning -> Attempt export when server returns error -> See export failure message

features.name: Data Export
features.description: Export child health data and reports to Excel with flexible filters like location and date range.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/export -> Select export criteria (by Puskesmas, date range) -> Submit export request -> Download Excel file containing filtered data
Navigate to /admin/export -> Select invalid date range (start date after end date) -> Submit export request -> See validation error about date range

features.name: Epidemiology Surveillance
features.description: Manage PD3I surveillance cases: create, view, edit, map and export cases with full case data capture.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/epidemiologi/ -> View datatable list of surveillance cases -> Create new case -> Fill patient identity, disease type and case data -> Submit case -> See new case in list
Navigate to /admin/epidemiologi/create -> Fill partial case data and submit -> See case saved with incomplete fields allowed for incremental updates
Navigate to /admin/epidemiologi/ -> Create new case missing mandatory identity fields -> Submit case -> See validation error for mandatory fields

features.name: Vaccine Master Data
features.description: Super-admin maintenance of vaccine master records (codes, schedules, active status) used to build immunization schedules.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/master-data/vaksin -> View vaccine list -> Add new vaccine with code, age ranges and intervals -> Submit form -> See new vaccine in list
Navigate to /admin/master-data/vaksin -> Deactivate a vaccine -> Save changes -> See vaccine excluded from new schedules (existing records preserved)
Navigate to /admin/master-data/vaksin -> Attempt to add vaccine without a code -> Submit form -> See validation error for required code

features.name: User Management
features.description: Super-admin management of system users and role/facility scoping to enforce RBAC across modules.
user_flows: Navigate to /super-admin/user -> View list of users -> Create new user with role and assigned facility -> Submit user creation -> See new user in list
Navigate to /super-admin/user -> Create user without role assignment -> Submit form -> See validation error for role
Navigate to /super-admin/user -> Create user with role 'imunisasi_faskes' assigned to a Puskesmas -> New user logs in -> See access limited to immunization modules and scoped facility data

features.name: Immunization Export
features.description: Export immunization data filtered by vaccine type, status and location for reporting.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/export-imunisasi -> View immunization datatable -> Apply filters for vaccine type and status -> Download export file with filtered immunization records
Navigate to /admin/export-imunisasi -> Apply filters that return no records -> Attempt download -> See 'No data to export' message

known_limitations.issue: DataTables loaded via AJAX — initial page load shows empty table until AJAX fires
known_limitations.impact: Test may see empty table on initial load before AJAX completes

known_limitations.issue: Geographic dropdowns (Kelurahan, Puskesmas, Posyandu, RT) are dependent — must select parent first
known_limitations.impact: Form cannot be fully filled without sequential dropdown selection

known_limitations.issue: Z-score calculation depends on WHO reference data in database
known_limitations.impact: Z-score values only appear if reference data exists in z_score table

known_limitations.issue: Map dashboard requires Leaflet.js CDN and correct geo-coordinate data
known_limitations.impact: Map may not render if CDN unavailable or geo-data missing
